focus_boat.name: Focus Map on Boat
focus_boat.description: Center and zoom the map on the boat's current position.

clear_waypoints.name: Clear Waypoints
clear_waypoints.description: Remove every waypoint currently placed on the map.

undo_waypoint.name: Undo Last Waypoint
undo_waypoint.description: Remove the most recently placed waypoint from the map.

pull_waypoints.name: Pull Waypoints from Server
pull_waypoints.description: Fetch waypoints from the telemetry server and add them to the map.

send_waypoints.name: Send Waypoints to Server
send_waypoints.description: Push the current waypoints to the telemetry server.

toggle_data_logging.name: Toggle Data Logging
toggle_data_logging.description: Start or stop logging telemetry data to a file.

open_tetris.name: Open Tetris
open_tetris.description: Can you play tetris on the phallic ice cream?

open_snake.name: Open Snake
open_snake.description: Eat the apples, don't bite your tail.
